ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across ~80% of the visible surface with high-intensity (white) pixels localized on distal regions and in scar patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling and linear streaks are concentrated on the outer 30% of both the left and right lobes. Central regions near the peduncle and the mid-lobe areas are solid low-intensity black, punctuated by high-contrast white circular rings (scars).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a defined depth extending towards the peduncle insertion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary. The right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (3-5 pixels) and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe, which shows a more moderated sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges of both lobes, sweeping outward and upward to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped clusters (scars) distributed across the medial and lateral surfaces of both lobes. Dense clusters of live barnacles (high-intensity white/grey) are located on the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of non-parallel linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally and diagonally, predominantly located on the white-mottled distal regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of circular barnacle attachment scars (rosettes) and multi-directional rake marks. Large, protruding barnacle colonies are present on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips are heavily encrusted with barnacles, creating a unique textural and pixel-intensity signature at the fluke extremities.
